ourPromiseText: We truly understand how interconnected continuous business is with the stability of the legal aspect of companies. Therefore, our office has developed its services as a law firm and in the field of legal consulting to promote this interconnection — holding all kinds of powers of attorney, commercial representation, and establishing companies. We are licensed to practice law and legal consulting and have all the experience and qualifications required to defend our clients and provide them with all types of legal consulting, including penal, civil, commercial, rental, labour, personal status, legacies, opening reports, debt collection, and providing various legal consulting services.

newsHighlightsSubtitle: Review the latest news, including coverage of the most significant matters, legal updates, media interviews and much more.
meetOurTeamSubtitle: A dedicated team of professionals committed to delivering excellence.
joinUsSubtitle: We are always looking for talented, driven individuals to join our growing team. Explore opportunities and take the next step in your career.
whoWeAreBody1: We are a leading legal firm with a long-standing reputation for excellence, integrity, and client-focused service. Our multidisciplinary team brings together expertise across corporate, litigation, arbitration, and advisory practices.
whoWeAreBody2: Founded on the principles of trust and professionalism, we have grown into one of the most respected legal institutions in the region. We serve clients ranging from individuals to multinational corporations.
whoWeAreBody3: At our firm, every team member is valued. We invest in our people through continuous learning, mentorship, and a culture that celebrates achievement and collaboration.
collaborativeBody: We believe great outcomes are built together. Our team thrives on open communication, shared goals, and mutual respect — creating a culture where everyone contributes and everyone succeeds.
impactfulBody: Every case, every client, every decision matters. We are driven by the real-world impact of our work and hold ourselves accountable to delivering results that truly make a difference.
consistencyBody: Excellence is not an act but a habit. We maintain the highest standards in every engagement — ensuring our clients receive reliable, quality service each and every time.
uniqueBody: We value and embrace the unique skills, experiences, and perspectives that each member of our team brings. Our diverse and inclusive approach allows us to offer innovative and tailored legal solutions that set us apart.
deiBody: The legal field has historically been male-dominated and although this is still prevalent, at our firm, we understand that diversity, equity, and inclusion are not just moral obligations, but also crucial for staying competitive. A firm with over 50 nationalities and teams that represent different backgrounds and experiences, we are better equipped to meet the needs of our clients from all walks of life. This multicultural and multilingual environment is a significant advantage for our clients, as it allows us to build stronger relationships and foster trust. Our diverse team helps us to understand different perspectives and cultural nuances, which ultimately leads to better outcomes for our clients. To further our commitment to promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion, our DEI working group consists of Legal and Business Services staff working together towards one common goal – creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive firm for all.
lifeSubtitle: We foster a culture of collaboration, growth, and well-being. Our team thrives in an environment where ideas are valued and people come first.
legalCareerBody: Your career is important to us, we will support your journey and ensure you maximise your potential. We stand by this commitment and have a track record of developing your aspirations. Many of our lawyers have joined the firm as an Associate and have progressed to Partner. In fact, our Managing Partner started his career at the firm and is today leading the Company.
professionalCareerBody: At the heart of the firm, our Business Services are pivotal. We consistently demonstrate our commitment to supporting and developing our personnel, ensuring they achieve their career goals to the fullest. We take pride in providing unwavering support to all our employees throughout their professional journeys. Importantly, our track record in talent development is illustrated by the journey of our Director of Administration, who began as a receptionist and now successfully leads our regional administrative function.
homeGrownBody: Supporting local talent is of utmost importance to us as the MENA region's leading law firm. Our commitment is evident through various initiatives, including providing financial assistance to local law students, nurturing young lawyers within our organisation to help them realize their full potential, and our unwavering dedication to recruiting the best local legal professionals. Local lawyers form an integral part of delivering well rounded solutions to our clients, and we take pride in celebrating and nurturing home grown talent to stay deeply connected in all our jurisdictions.
